claims: The Artemis II Orion capsule is scheduled to splash down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California.
The Artemis II Orion capsule is scheduled to splash down on Friday, April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II Orion capsule is scheduled to splash down at approximately 8:07 p.m. EDT (5:07 p.m. PDT).
Splashdown coverage starts at 6:30 p.m. EDT on NASA+.
The Artemis II crew will be recovered by the USS John P. Murtha.
Live coverage is available on NASA's YouTube channel.
The Artemis II crew's return marks the conclusion of their mission around the Moon.
The Artemis II Orion capsule will use a "skip entry" technique to manage heat.
The Artemis II Orion capsule will deploy parachutes to slow down for the final water landing.
